pick.headline: Norwegian research rocket triggers Russian nuclear alert
pick.summary: On January 25, 1995, Russian early-warning radar detected a Norwegian scientific rocket launched from Andoya, and President Yeltsin's nuclear briefcase was activated.
pick.significance: Norway had notified Russia of the launch, but the warning never reached the right people. It was among the most dangerous false alarms of the nuclear age.
pick.fbis: The Central Eurasia Daily Report of January 26, 1995, carried Moscow ITAR-TASS reports that Russian air defenses "did not shoot down" a missile said to have violated Russian airspace from a North European country, and that Washington doubted the incident had happened.

alternates.headline: Gunman kills two outside CIA headquarters
alternates.summary: On January 25, 1993, a gunman opened fire on cars waiting to enter CIA headquarters in Langley, Virginia, killing two agency employees.
alternates.significance: The killer, Mir Aimal Kasi, fled to Pakistan and was captured there in 1997. The attack was an early sign of anti-American terrorism linked to the Afghan war's aftermath.
